messages:
maria: Quick async update: rolling canary for ff=release_v7 started at 09:10 PT at 3%. Observability looks stable so far — p95 ~180ms. tagging @lee @olivia for perf/QA.
akash: On it. I'll keep an eye on model fallback behavior (A->B). Any regen failures yet?
jamie: Saw a short 502 spike around 09:23 (~5m), recovered after autoscale. Logs show: `backend: upstream timeout 504` — digging into host logs.
maria: Thanks. We bumped burst pool and removed a noisy connection. Bumped canary to 10% at 09:40 PT. Hold on long-tail perf checks for ~30m.
olivia: Running prompt set 4 against the canary. One hallucination regression in test-case "billing-summary" — dropping example in #evals.
jamie: Can you paste the example here?
olivia: Example: "...customer charged twice for invoice X..." (sending exact utterance to #evals, low volume)
akash: If regression rate > 1% at 10% we should pause. What's the current error/regression rate?
sre-bot: deploy-bot: Canary increase to 10% succeeded. Metrics snapshot: 5xx_rate=0.12% | p95=182ms | cpu_avg=63%.
lee: No infra alerts. Running a quick smoke: `curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"ping"}'`
maria: Plan: hold at 10% for 30m, then 25% if green. If hallucination >0.5% we pause and revert model to v6 with ff `release_v7_fallback=true`.
jamie: Ack. I'll review the rollout policy CR and tag infra for extra log retention during full ramp.
olivia: QA will run full suite by 10:30 PT and post results here.
akash: Noted one host (i-0abc123) showing higher latency tail — I'm investigating disk IO on that instance.
maria: :thumbsup: thanks. I'll update when we hit 25% or if any blocker.

maria: UPDATE 10:45 PT — bumped to 25%. No additional regressions observed in sampled traces. Hallucination sample ~0.08% on our test set.
jamie: Queued cleanup ticket for canary config and a post-rollout perf blast (will assign tomorrow).
olivia: QA passed core flows. Approving continued rollout.
akash: Monitoring thresholds set. Will escalate if p95>300ms or 5xx>0.5%.
maria: Closing async check-in. Thanks everyone :tada: — final plan is gradual 25%->50%->100% over ~3 hours with 15m stabilization windows.
